concepts.title: Purpose of Sub-titling a Long Text
concepts.definition: Sub-titles break a long piece of writing into signposted sections, each heading naming the idea of its block. They let a reader see at a glance the map of the whole argument and locate any sub-topic without rereading.
concepts.key_idea: Sub-titles are signposts -- each one names the stretch of road the reader is on.

solution_steps.explain: Read for the points where the text moves to a new sub-topic -- those are section boundaries.
Summarise each section's single governing idea in a short heading.
Read the sub-titles in sequence: they should trace the whole argument like chapter titles.

concepts.title: Qualities of a Good Sub-title
concepts.definition: A good sub-title is brief, striking and faithful: short enough to scan, memorable enough to stick, and true to the section's content -- never wider or narrower than the block it heads. Parallel phrasing across sub-titles adds polish.
concepts.key_idea: Short, sharp and exact -- a sub-title must fit its section like a label on a jar.

solution_steps.explain: Trim each candidate to its leanest accurate form -- usually a phrase, not a sentence.
Confirm the heading covers exactly the section's content, no more and no less.
Line up all sub-titles for consistent style and non-overlapping coverage.

concepts.title: Sub-titling as a Study and Writing Tool
concepts.definition: Beyond reading aid, sub-titling trains writers to structure their own compositions: deciding section boundaries and naming them before drafting imposes a clear plan. It also doubles as a comprehension exercise -- a set of accurate sub-titles proves the reader has grasped each section's point.
concepts.key_idea: Name the blocks before you build them -- sub-titling is planning made visible.

solution_steps.explain: Framing sub-titles for an unbroken text forces section-by-section comprehension.
Fixing headings first gives an essay a skeleton that paragraphs can flesh out.
Sub-titling sits between note-making's compression and summarising's fidelity -- all three discipline reading.

worked_examples.question_pattern: A passage on the benefits of exercise has three unmarked blocks: physical gains, mental gains, and how to begin. Frame suitable sub-titles.

solution_template.explain: Shifts from body to mind to method mark the three section boundaries.
Suggested sub-titles: Fitness for the Body; Fitness for the Mind; Taking the First Step.
Each title is brief, parallel and exactly as wide as its block.

worked_examples.question_pattern: For a section that discusses only the cost of solar panels, choose between 'Solar Energy' and 'The Price Question' as sub-title, and justify.

solution_template.explain: 'Solar Energy' covers everything about solar power -- too wide for a cost-only section.
'The Price Question' names exactly the section's concern.
The narrower, apter heading obeys the fit rule; wide titles blur the text's map.
